newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: LG Group offers to buy Jinro's real estate.
newsitem.headline: LG Group offers to buy Jinro's real estate.

text.p: South Korea's giant LG Group has offered to buy one of two real estate plots in southern Seoul from the financially troubled Jinro Group, a Jinro Group spokesman said on Monday.
LG Group was the first to offer to purchase the land, used as a bus terminal, but Jinro is still waiting for other offers, spokesman Kim Sang-soo said.
"LG Group tendered the first offer on Saturday to buy the bus terminal plot at 180 billion won ($201 million)," Kim told Reuters. "But no contract has been signed yet."
Kim said Jinro hoped to raise 250 billion won from the sale of the bus terminal lot.
Jinro Group on Friday briefed fellow conglomerates and business people on its plan to sell assets ranging from food factories to department stores.
The plan, which Jinro hopes will raise some 1.2 trillion won, is being promoted in line with its drive to streamline affiliates.
Jinro Group, the nation's 19th largest conglomerate, has suffered financial troubles because of debts estimated at 3.2 trillion won.
